dispute_description: AmritRasa Beverages Pvt Ltd manufactures and sells packaged fruit juices under the registered trademark AMRIT RASA. AmritRush Drinks Pvt Ltd has launched similar fruit juices under the brand name AMRIT RUSH, with deceptively similar packaging, logo, and color combination. This is causing confusion among consumers who mistake the respondent's goods for those of the claimant. AmritRasa seeks a permanent injunction and damages of Rs 30 lakhs.
